admissionPolicy: EXACT mapping and all required PostgreSQL executions plus parent admission required; GAP and SUPPORTING_PARTIAL explicitly HOLD. Candidate methods never count as proof.
reviewBasis: BSR R1.1 semantic repair: 18 invalid bindings removed; all remaining mappings supporting only until variant review.

scenarios.behavior: Verified account provisions exactly one first organization tenant
scenarios.openRequirement: Signed access token → resolver → onboarding; restart/replay и независимый подсчёт org/member/orphan.

scenarios.behavior: Unverified suspended or foreign principal cannot provision or select tenant
scenarios.openRequirement: Отказы onboarding и JWT пока в разных тестах; проверить все owner-дельты.

scenarios.behavior: Active tenant staff obtains only explicit functional grants
scenarios.openRequirement: Связать invite/accept/grants и бизнес-команду с signed identity и AB-grants в одном варианте.

scenarios.behavior: Active employee/order → revoke and confirm A→B/B→A → committed authorized winner only
scenarios.openRequirement: Both permission-revoke/confirm schedules implemented with signed JWT and observed PG blocking edge. Account/membership suspension variants and persisted independent evidence still pending.

scenarios.behavior: Linked buyer → suspend/delete races link read/checkout → no post-revoke new access, retain permitted immutable evidence
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Authorized staff operations require current selected warehouse assignment
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к складу не относится к блокировке покупателя; раздельно checkout/link/read и retention.

scenarios.behavior: Warehouse A grant only → attempt B; revoke × pick/handover both orders → scope enforced
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Cross tenant grants and revocation are isolated
scenarios.openRequirement: Both pick/revoke schedules added to existing scope-revocation test; legacy handover schedules remain supporting. Full strict verified QR setup and durable evidence pending.

scenarios.behavior: An active warehouse cannot be deactivated after reserved stock commits
scenarios.openRequirement: Разделить INACTIVE с остатком и CLOSED без остатка; нормативное расхождение §12.3.

scenarios.behavior: Deactivation first prevents later stock reservation
scenarios.openRequirement: Дополнить остальные пары transfer/confirm/close из того же класса; сохранить остаток при законной деактивации.

scenarios.behavior: Customer contact interaction and contract persisted tenant scoped
scenarios.openRequirement: Нужны PERSON и COMPANY, same-name без merge, независимые encrypted/foreign-row oracles.

scenarios.behavior: Two updates with same version, search empty/bounded/filter → one correct version, no foreign rows
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Contact and interaction access limited by current CRM permission
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к readonly interaction не доказывает customer/contact CAS и поиск.

scenarios.behavior: Archive customer/contract × open order creation both orders → approved policy, order snapshot retained
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Contact consent revocation overrides earlier grant
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к consent ошибочна; заказ связан с IAM buyer, не прямо с CRM customer/contract; нужен контракт архивации и hash заказа.

scenarios.behavior: Record interaction→assign→nextAction→complete; repeated request and inactive assignee → correct history
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Customer and contract archive preserves history but blocks prohibited work
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к архиву не покрывает record/assign/nextAction/complete; проверить каждый шаг и history.

scenarios.behavior: Explicit verified buyer link is required to expose order history
scenarios.openRequirement: Проверить оба независимых CRM_READ/SALES_ORDER_READ и отсутствие infer-by-email; source test body не заменяет run.

scenarios.behavior: Dispute and revocation hide seller order history without mutating ledger
scenarios.openRequirement: Последовательный dispute supporting; confirm × revoke не равен orderHistory × revoke; read linearization отдельно.

scenarios.behavior: Published product SKU and price are tenant qualified
scenarios.openRequirement: Дополнить точные price/quantity bounds, invalid currency и negative zero-effect oracles.

scenarios.behavior: Catalog version CAS prevents stale price revision and cross tenant write
scenarios.openRequirement: Catalog CAS сам по себе не доказывает коммерческую цену; проверить обе истории и old-order hash при drift.

scenarios.behavior: Active sellable SKU cannot be archived across concurrent offers
scenarios.openRequirement: В том же классе есть receipt-first; stocktake race и обе стороны всех конфликтов требуют отдельной привязки.

scenarios.behavior: Seller storefront publish pause resume preserve revision and audit
scenarios.openRequirement: Resume выполняется publish с актуальной версией; отдельно revoked role, inactive workspace и tenant.

scenarios.behavior: Offer authoritative price version and accepted order snapshot are consistent
scenarios.openRequirement: У price update CAS/no-op, а не универсальный request-key receipt; привязать hide и invalid product.

scenarios.behavior: Paused storefront cannot accept new checkout
scenarios.openRequirement: Оба теста кандидаты; доказать именно publication и оба управляемых порядка pause × checkout.

scenarios.behavior: Single seller checkout uses immutable accepted price and SKU snapshot
scenarios.openRequirement: Сквозной happy path из старой карты не доказывает конфликт ключа; отдельно lost response и process restart.

scenarios.behavior: Price/pause change×checkout both orders → acknowledged version or reconfirm, no new order on deny
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Duplicate checkout request cannot produce duplicate orders or receipts
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к duplicate checkout не покрывает stale price/pause; отдельно verified QR и обычный route.

scenarios.behavior: Full reserve only after seller confirmation
scenarios.openRequirement: Кандидаты вызывают внутренние методы; нужен verified facade, multi-line snapshot и один склад в strict mode.

scenarios.behavior: Insufficient stock rolls back all reservations and status
scenarios.openRequirement: Shortage/outer rollback не равны hard crash; подтвердить last-line failure и отсутствие всех success-эффектов.

scenarios.behavior: Two orders compete for last units and reversed SKU ordering → no oversell/deadlock leak
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Reserved stock and ledger remain atomic with order completion
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая проверка fulfillment не является hot-SKU race; нужны управляемые schedules и отрицательные ledger oracles.

scenarios.behavior: Cancel×confirm and cancel×fulfill both orders → one valid final state/release/debit
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Seller denial preserves state and order inventory history
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к permission deny ошибочна; random race не заменяет оба заданных порядка cancel × confirm/fulfill.

scenarios.behavior: Cancellation before pick releases once and retries idempotently
scenarios.openRequirement: Есть последовательный picked-deny; не найден самостоятельный детерминированный pick × cancel в обоих порядках.

scenarios.behavior: Proof-required QR order cannot use generic fulfillment
scenarios.openRequirement: SQL fixture proof-mode допустим для локального fence; полный путь должен создавать mode через verified QR checkout.

scenarios.behavior: Generic fulfill×secure pickup both orders → exactly one legal debit with proof
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Order state and stock movement history trace each completed business order
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к BUS happy path неверна; double-scan не заменяет generic fulfill × secure pickup на одном заказе.

scenarios.behavior: Warehouse grants A not B; revoke × each confirm/prepare/fulfill both orders
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Partial physical pick prevents silent order cancellation
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к picked cancel неверна; квалифицировать strict flag и оба revoke orders для каждой операции.

scenarios.behavior: Same request key stock posting records one movement
scenarios.openRequirement: Один same-key movement не покрывает transfer/stocktake; расширить реальные команды и ledger baseline.

scenarios.behavior: Reserved on hand ledger conserves quantities under concurrent checkout and reconciliation
scenarios.openRequirement: Отличать per-page REPEATABLE_READ и durable cursor от tenant-wide immutable snapshot; foreign/empty/end cases.

scenarios.behavior: Published product QR remains stable and reflects authoritative offer price
scenarios.openRequirement: Стабильный reprint недостаточен; два revoke × checkout schedules и exact committed replay.

scenarios.behavior: Hidden unpublished and revoked references never expose public card
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка проверяет visibility без bytes; negative storage invocation и public derivative отделить от original.

scenarios.behavior: Available/partial/unknown region preview including empty → advisory only
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Public QR and cross tenant access never grant private order ownership
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к private order read не относится к regional advisory; проверить zero reservation и отсутствие warehouse leakage.

scenarios.behavior: List price checkout requires active verified buyer and exact price/version
scenarios.openRequirement: Основной entrypoint checkoutVerified; email-first checkout по умолчанию закрыт; price race отдельно.

scenarios.behavior: Buyer and seller alternate valid bargaining turns and persist agreement
scenarios.openRequirement: Добавить точную привязку reject, self-accept, request conflict и конкурентный revision CAS.

scenarios.behavior: Accepted quote creates an immutable priced order with buyer identity
scenarios.openRequirement: Accepted happy path не доказывает разные ключи/namespace/restart; scope receipt tenant+key, quote uniqueness отдельно.

scenarios.behavior: Expire/withdraw/revoke/suspend×checkout both orders, exact cutoff → winner only
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Accepted quote can be consumed at most once across competing checkout requests
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к double consumption ошибочна; для expire/withdraw/QR revoke/suspend нужны свои состояния и оба порядка.

scenarios.behavior: Order preparation requires full reserved pick before READY without stock debit
scenarios.openRequirement: Полный pick/ready/no early debit есть как кандидат; сохранить отдельный incomplete-pick отрицательный oracle.

scenarios.behavior: Buyer issues credential; scoped staff previews; foreign/expired deny
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Warehouse scope revoke prevents unauthorized picking
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к preparation не доказывает issue/preview; wrong warehouse/expiry и zero IO/stock отдельно.

scenarios.behavior: Only verified buyer can issue fresh one time pickup proof
scenarios.openRequirement: Issue-only не доказывает debit; reissue через issue с новым ключом; старый proof, replay и unique receipt.

scenarios.behavior: Multiple simultaneous pickup scans produce one stock debit
scenarios.openRequirement: Двухпоточный scan не равен two-JVM; добавить revoke-first и handover-first, account и permission variants.

scenarios.behavior: Crash after commit and lost response cannot cause second stock debit
scenarios.openRequirement: Реальные Runtime.halt workers существуют; отдельно SQL fault при receipt/credential и run logs с кодами выхода.

scenarios.behavior: Return claims cannot exceed quantity in immutable completed handover
scenarios.openRequirement: Capacity учитывает все незакрытые claims кроме REJECTED/CANCELLED_BY_BUYER; проверить состояния и independent sum.

scenarios.behavior: Only authorized staff reviews and approves return with durable evidence
scenarios.openRequirement: Review не равен physical reception; proof issue/consume, wrong warehouse, replay и no early stock.

scenarios.behavior: Receipt inspection and restock link one returned quantity to one stock movement
scenarios.openRequirement: Связать RESTOCK movement по posting.movement_id; QUARANTINE отдельный ledger, WRITE_OFF без sellable credit.

scenarios.behavior: Concurrent quarantine resolution in both orders → one resolution/conserved qty
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Damaged or quarantined returns never increase sellable stock
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая проверка disposition не доказывает resolution race; проверить два заданных порядка RESTOCK/DISPOSE и immutable original.

scenarios.behavior: Repeated physical returns cannot post a second restock movement
scenarios.openRequirement: Two-JVM duplicate не заменяет crash; добавить reception duplicate и исходный COMPLETED hash.

scenarios.behavior: Business journey integrates IAM CRM TASK catalog stock and order
scenarios.openRequirement: BUS использует new VerifiedActor, обычную TASK и email-first checkout; CRM buyer link, cancellation и signed chain не доказаны одним journey.

scenarios.behavior: Verified QR list price reaches immutable pickup and returned stock
scenarios.openRequirement: Два маршрута существуют, decoder stub; tenant/email/warehouse setup через SQL/repos; нет WRITE_OFF полного J1.

scenarios.behavior: A/B/AB actor tries foreign customer/offer/order/stock/QR/media using UUIDs and list filters
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Negotiated quote reaches pickup and segregated quarantine
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к negotiated happy path неверна; собрать A/B/AB по всем owner reads/list/count/history/bytes.

scenarios.behavior: Populated old schema→Liquibase→restart→read and replay historical orders/link/receipt/stock
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Cross tenant stock and order commands have no side effects
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к oversell не относится к upgrade; использовать populated workflows, baseline schema/fixtures, restore и hash исторических rows.

scenarios.behavior: Frozen candidate SHA → mandatory H2/PG/security/infra jobs and per-ID evidence → no unexpected skip
scenarios.legacyBehavior: Seller suspension and checkout in both commit orders preserve one order snapshot
scenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к seller suspend × checkout неверна; gate является workflow+verifier+artifact set, не одним JUnit методом.

taskAddendum.openRequirement: Full semantic variant and oracle review pending
